tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.bestFor: General-purpose AI assistance: writing, analysis, images, voice, and everyday problem solving in one interface.

verification.note: Official pricing page states: "The free version of ChatGPT is available to everyone." Limits on uploads, image creation, and voice are marked as limited on the free plan.

tools.name: Claude
tools.bestFor: Long-form writing, document work, coding assistance, and structured thinking with artifacts you can iterate on.

verification.note: Official pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 "Free for everyone" (web, desktop, mobile) with usage limits, and paid Pro/Max tiers above it.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.bestFor: People already living in Google's ecosystem (Gmail, Docs, Drive) plus research, study, and multimodal tasks.

verification.note: Official subscriptions page lists a personal plan at zero cost with a Google account, with paid Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra tiers above it. Availability and limits vary by country.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.bestFor: Answer-style research with citations — useful when you want sources attached to an answer instead of a blank chat box.

verification.note: Official help center confirms paid plans (Pro and above) and a subscription structure, but our check on 2026-10-15 could not confirm current free-tier limits from an official page that loads without JavaScript. Verify on the official site before relying on a free tier.
